description: Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Aviation - Merchant Shipping Act, No. 52 of 1971
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister under the Merchant Shipping Act, No. 52 of 1971. It specifically amends the Merchant Shipping (Standards of Training, Certification and Watch Keeping for Seafarers) Regulations, 2016. This content falls under "Legal/Regulatory Gazettes" as it involves regulatory frameworks, legal amendments, and statutory instruments related to maritime operations and safety standards. While it mentions a minister's name, it does not focus on government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities, but rather on the regulatory content itself.
